ONE WEEK until MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY arrives on NETFLIX!

The fourth instalment of Ryan Murphy and Ian Brennan’s ‘MONSTER’ series will depict the infamous 1892 case that shocked America.

Ella Beatty stars as Lizzie Borden, the woman accused of brutally killing her father and stepmother with a hatchet inside their Massachusetts home. She was later acquitted, but the murders remain unsolved more than 130 years later.

All eight episodes drop September 17.
